description: This file defines a class for processing and analyzing medical images using OpenAI's GPT-4V model, including reading image files, encoding them, and generating detailed analysis prompts.

classes.name: ImageProcessor
classes.description: A class to process and analyze medical images using GPT-4V, encapsulating image encoding and interaction with the OpenAI API.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the ImageProcessor with an OpenAI client using API key from settings.

methods.name: analyze_image
methods.description: Asynchronously analyzes a medical image at a given path with optional contextual information, returning a detailed analysis generated by GPT-4V.
